A Foundation for Lasting Change

True recovery requires more than just abstinence; it requires a complete neurological and emotional reset. Our residential program in San Francisco is designed for individuals who need a highly structured, supportive environment to address the underlying psychological drivers of addiction. By stepping away from the triggers of daily life and into our boutique facility, you gain the space needed to rebuild your life with 24/7 clinical support and evidence-based therapeutic interventions. Evidence-Based Therapies for Transformation

At Marina Harbor, we utilize a combination of scientifically proven therapies and holistic practices to support your recovery. Our residential program is not just about time away; it is about active, engaged work to reshape your future. By addressing the cognitive, emotional, and physical aspects of addiction, we help you develop the tools necessary for long-term sobriety. Our core therapeutic modalities include:
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT): Identify and reframe the negative thought patterns that drive self-destructive behaviors and substance use.
Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT): Gain essential skills in emotional regulation, distress tolerance, and interpersonal effectiveness.
Trauma-Informed Care: Safely process underlying trauma in a secure environment, addressing the root causes that often fuel addictive cycles.
Relapse Prevention Planning: Develop a personalized "toolkit" of healthy coping mechanisms to navigate high-risk situations after you leave our care.
Family Systems Therapy: Heal the family unit through guided communication and education, rebuilding trust and establishing a healthy support system.

In addition to clinical sessions, our residential experience includes wellness-focused activities designed to restore your physical health. From chef-prepared nutritional support to mindfulness and meditation, every element of your stay is curated to promote total well-being.

Specialized programs for professionals and more
Tailored Programs for Unique Life Demands

At Marina Harbor, we provide specialized treatment tracks designed to meet the unique cultural, professional, and social needs of our residents. By grouping individuals with shared life experiences, we foster a deeper sense of community and more relevant clinical breakthroughs. We offer customized residential programs for:
First Responders: Specialized trauma-informed care for police, fire, and EMS personnel. We address the unique stressors of the front lines in a secure, peer-supported environment.
Men’s Specific Program: A focused environment addressing the social and psychological factors unique to men’s recovery
Women’s Specific Program: A private, nurturing sanctuary designed to address women’s specific health needs, trauma processing, and the complexities of balancing family and self-care.
Young Adults: A dynamic program focused on life-skills development, academic/career planning, and building a sober foundation during the critical transition into adulthood.

Professionals & Executives: Tailored for high-functioning individuals in the Bay Area, this track offers monitored technology access and burnout-focused clinical support, allowing you to maintain professional discretion while you heal.

Serving San Francisco, The Bay Area and More

Healing begins with the right environment. Nestled in the heart of San Francisco’s iconic Marina District, our facility provides a sophisticated and secure sanctuary for those seeking a higher standard of clinical care.
